newsitem.title: USA: California home builders still struggling - report.
newsitem.headline: California home builders still struggling - report.

text.p: California home builders are on track to produce only 94,900 new housing units by year-end, a figure that reflects the industry's struggle to emerge from recession, according to a report Tuesday.
The revised forecast, released by the Construction Industry Research Board, was up slightly from the previous 94,500-unit estimate because of a small increase in residential building in September.
The annual production estimates are revised monthly by the Construction Industry Research Board based on the number of housing permits already issued statewide during the year.
The 94,900-unit forecast was based on the 71,512 residential building permits issued through September.
